title: Article 123 — Power of President to promulgate Ordinances

content.heading: Power of President to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament
content.text: If at any time, except when both Houses of Parliament are in session, the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary for him to take immediate action, he may promulgate such Ordinances as the circumstances appear to him to require. An Ordinance has the same force and effect as an Act of Parliament but must be laid before both Houses and ceases if not approved as enacted.
